content: Compound Primitive Data Type For clarification, a “com- pound primitive data type” is an ApplicationPrimitiveDataType of category STRING , CURVE , MAP , CUBOID , CUBE_4 , CUBE_5 , COM_AXIS , RES_AXIS , and VAL_ BLK . This implies the existence of a swRecordLayout owned by the swDataDefProps of the ApplicationPrimitiveDataType that defines the mapping to a corresponding ImplementationDataType . The main characteristic of the “compound primitive data type” is that with respect to the application data type layer its data type is considered a primitive data type but when it comes to the implementation data type layer the type is implemented as a composite data type according to the applicable SwRecordLayout .
